Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Sunil Kumar

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Nawal Kishore Prasad
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Arvind Srivastava
 Oral Order
8 17-05-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

Petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Jehanabad Mahila P.S. Case No. 41 of 2021 registered for the offence under sections 498A, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has not committed any offence as alleged in the first information report and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that from the very beginning the informant and her family members started pressurizing the father of the petitioner for transfer of landed property in the name of the informant.

Thereafter under pressure his father transferred the landed property in the name of the informant worth more than Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.33337 of 2022(8) dt.17-05-2023 rupees thirty four lakhs.
But even after that the informant was not ready to reside with the petitioner.
Moreover, prior to filing of the present first information report, the petitioner had filed a divorce case in the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Saket, Delhi.
